{#- Beneficiary Certificate (Sales Invoice). The usual LC requirement: the beneficiary certifies that non-negotiable documents went to the applicant. Edit the wording to the LC's clause 46A. -#} {%- import "india_exim/templates/print_formats/exim_macros.html" as exim -%} {%- set shipment_name = frappe.db.get_value("Export Shipment Invoice", {"sales_invoice": doc.name, "parenttype": "Export Shipment"}, "parent") -%} {%- set shipment = frappe.get_doc("Export Shipment", shipment_name) if shipment_name else None -%} {{ exim.style() }}
{{ exim.cell(_("Letter of Credit No. & Date"), (doc.get("exim_lc_number") or "") ~ ((" / " ~ exim.date(doc.exim_lc_date)) if doc.get("exim_lc_date") else "")) }} {{ exim.cell(_("Invoice No. & Date"), doc.name ~ " / " ~ exim.date(doc.posting_date)) }}
{{ _("BENEFICIARY CERTIFICATE") }}
{{ exim.exporter(doc, _("Beneficiary")) }} {{ exim.party(doc, "buyer", _("Applicant")) }}

{{ _("We hereby certify that:") }}

1. {{ _("One full set of non-negotiable shipping documents, including copies of the commercial invoice, packing list and transport document{0}, has been sent to the applicant by courier{1}.").format( (" " ~ _("No.") ~ " " ~ shipment.bl_number) if shipment and shipment.bl_number else "", (" " ~ _("on or before {0}").format(exim.date(frappe.utils.add_days(shipment.bl_date, 5)))) if shipment and shipment.bl_date else "") }}

2. {{ _("The goods shipped are of {0} origin and conform to the description, quantity and quality stated in the letter of credit and the buyer's order{1}.").format(_("Indian"), (" " ~ doc.po_no) if doc.po_no else "") }}

3. {{ _("The marks and numbers on the packages are as stated in the invoice: {0}").format(doc.get("exim_marks_and_numbers") or "-") }}

{{ exim.signature(doc.company) }}
name: Beneficiary Certificate
